lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Chicken Nugget here. Today: an athletic event of historic proportions.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: It is seven a.m.. Conditions are perfect. The distance: zero point two miles.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Okay. Big day. Did you stretch?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I stretched yesterday. It should still count.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Point two miles is no joke, Kat.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: It is a little bit of a joke.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: That's nearly a third of a kilometre.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Did you just convert it, to make it sound longer?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Yes.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: For the record, I run this distance every time someone opens the fridge.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Why are you wearing a headband?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: For the sweat.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: There will be no sweat.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: There might be sweat.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Runners, take your marks. I will be supervising, from a position of authority.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: On three. One, two,

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Wait. Is it on three, or after three?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: On three.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: So we go when you say three.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Yes.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Okay. You're very serious right now, and I respect it.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Three!

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: And they're off! A blistering pace. I am walking.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Breathe in through the nose. Out through the mouth.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I'm breathing in through everything.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Zero point zero five miles. One quarter of the way. Emotions are high.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: How far have we gone?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Point oh five.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: That's it? I have lived a whole life since the start.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: You're doing great. Look at your form.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I'm running in a coat, Blake.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: And you look incredible.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I know.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: We are now passing the nice houses. Please keep your paws inside the route.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Okay, wait. Look at that one. The arches. The balcony. The flowers.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: That one is unreal.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: And that one, with the columns, and the little fountain. Who lives like this?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: People with very good taste. You would like Georgia. Big porches. Bigger trees.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Georgia.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I'm just saying. You could come see it. Maybe.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Maybe. I would need to see the porches first.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: For the record, they are just friends. I have noted that she is smiling at a hedge.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Halfway. Traditionally, this is where champions are made, and snacks are discussed.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I was promised ice cream.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Ice cream, and warm cookies. At the finish.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Warm? How warm?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Fresh out of the oven warm.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Why didn't you lead with that?

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Observe. Her pace has doubled.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Okay. This is the wall. Everyone hits the wall.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: There's no wall. It's a hedge.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: It's a metaphor.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: It's a hedge, Blake.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Zero point one five. I have stopped to smell a flower. I remain in the lead.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: How is the dog winning?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Chicken Nugget has never doubted anything. Ever.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I can see the finish line!

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Race you.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: We're already racing.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Race you faster.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: And here they come. Shoulder to shoulder. A photo finish,

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: won, comfortably, by me.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: We did it. Point two miles.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I would like it noted that I never stopped.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Noted. You were amazing.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: You were very encouraging. Slightly too encouraging.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Official time: irrelevant. Official verdict: adorable. Proceed to refreshments.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: The post-race recovery meal. Ice cream. Warm cookies. And, for the champion, a pup cup.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Okay. This was worth point two miles.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Only point two?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Fine. Point two five.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: You've got a little ice cream, right there.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Where?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: No, other side. I'll, there.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Smooth.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I've been training.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: The cookie is still warm.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I told you. Fresh out of the oven.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: You planned this whole thing around dessert, didn't you?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I planned it around you. The dessert was the bribe.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: That was good. Did you rehearse that?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: On the run. Around the wall.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: The hedge.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: The hedge.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: They are sharing a spoon. I am pretending not to notice. I notice everything.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Also. What is the surprise?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I can't tell you. That is how surprises work.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: One hint.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: No.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Same time next week?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Point three miles?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Let's not get carried away.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: And that is how two people ran not very far at all, and ended up exactly where they wanted to be.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Later. The drive home. Yes, the G-Wagon's back window is broken. We do not talk about the back window.

lines.name: Kat's friend, on the phone
lines.text: Okay, tell me everything. How was the run?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: It was zero point two miles. And then ice cream, and warm cookies. He planned the whole thing.

lines.name: Kat's friend, on the phone
lines.text: Hold on. Is this the guy from TikTok?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Yes.

lines.name: Kat's friend, on the phone
lines.text: The meme guy! I knew it!

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Stop. We are just friends.

lines.name: Kat's friend, on the phone
lines.text: Mm hmm.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Okay, fine. I like him. I really like him.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: I heard that. I hear everything. Also, there is a draft back here.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: So we ran point two miles, and then I got her ice cream and warm cookies.

lines.name: Blake's cousin, on the phone
lines.text: Point two? That's a parking lot, man. Wait. Are you calling me from the new Mercedes?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Maybe. It still smells new.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: It was a race cookie date. It's a thing now.

lines.name: Blake's cousin, on the phone
lines.text: So what is this? Are you two together?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: We're just having fun right now. Seeing what may happen in the future.

lines.name: Blake's cousin, on the phone
lines.text: But you like her.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Yeah. I like her. A lot.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Hang on. I have to make one more call.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Hey, it's Blake. Just checking in on the surprise. Is everything on track?

lines.name: On the phone
lines.text: All set. She is going to love it.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Perfect. And not a word. She keeps asking.

lines.name: On the phone
lines.text: My lips are sealed.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Night. Two houses. Two phones. One very obvious idea.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Do you want to talk on the phone?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Do you want to talk on the phone?

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: They sent it at the same time. Of course they did.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: This has been Chicken Nugget. Good night, and good cookies.
